Use when user asks to 'analyze market', 'calculate RSI', 'check EMA', 'compute bollinger bands', 'buy BTC', 'sell ETH', 'place order', 'long perp', 'short swap', 'set stop loss', 'set take profit', 'check positions', 'cancel order', 'set leverage', 'trailing stop', or any quantitative analysis + order execution task on OKX. Do NOT use for grid/DCA bots (use okx-cex-bot).
